## ⛔ Pull requests are closed right now

**libi is in beta and is not accepting pull requests from outside the core team.** PRs
opened here will be closed without review.

This isn't about the quality of your work — the architecture is still moving fast and
we're still settling code ownership, testing standards, and the contribution workflow.
We'd rather not have you spend hours on a patch we can't merge, or leave you sitting on a
branch that goes stale underneath you.

**Issues are open and genuinely welcome.** Bug reports, reproductions, crashes, and
feature requests are the most useful thing you can send us right now:
👉 https://github.com/Nagellabs/libi/issues

We'll announce it here and in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) when PRs open up.
